item.title: The Raja Saab Box Office Collections: Prabhas starrer crash and burn in second weekend, 179cr worldwide in 10 days
item.description: The Raja Saab collected Rs. 9.50 crore approx in its second weekend at the Indian box office. This marks a steep 83 per cent drop from its opening weekend, with its ten-day running total reaching Rs. 146.50 crore approx in India. Overseas, the Prabhas starrer has added Rs. 32.50 crore (USD 3.60 million) approx, taking the worldwide box office total to Rs. 179 crore approx. item.description: Avatar: Fire and Ash, directed by James Cameron, is recording a good hold at the box office. The sci-fi action adventure drama added around Rs. 3.75 crore to the tally in its 5th weekend. The Sivakarthikeyan starrer opened on a decent note and then it recorded some good growth, but slipped to a new low on its 2nd Sunday.
